name: web-architecture-home-hero-with-serif-title-blush-sky-and-glass-card-with-3d-house
title: Custom-home builder hero: giant taupe serif 'THE PERFECT HOME' over a mountain field, a white card with a rounded 3D house and a room-tour pill
whatItIs: A blush-grey sky and dark grass landscape inside a framed page with a thin nav and a Contact link, a huge dark taupe serif 'THE PERFECT HOME®' with 'We craft custom homes' and a dark pill START, a big white rounded card with tag pills, a 3D rounded wood-clad house with hotspot dots, a 'ROOMTOUR' preview tile and play button, a taupe card about materials with a wall cross-section, avatars with '12m+ customers' and a light statement 'WE CAN COMBINE NATURE & HOME COMFORT'.
whatItMeans: Warm and refined; taupe serif and a soft sunset sky feel like a calm luxury build.
techniques: Set a giant serif title on a landscape photo.
Overlay a white card holding a 3D model with hotspots.
Use a taupe card with a cross-section illustration.
Keep a warm blush and taupe palette.

vocabulary.definition: A dot marking an interactive point on a 3D model.
A small preview with a play button.
A cutaway drawing of a wall.
A serif headline in muted brown-grey.
